citation: Shady Solís, Ruth; Haas, Jonathan; Creamer, Winifred. 2001. “Dating Caral, a Preceramic Site in the Supe Valley on the Central Coast of Peru.” Science 292 (5517): 723–726. DOI 10.1126/science.1059519.
notes: Peer-reviewed Science article. Abstract/publisher line (Science.org): radiocarbon dates place monumental corporate architecture, urban settlement, and irrigation agriculture at Caral between 4090 yr BP (2627 cal BCE) and 3640 yr BP (1977 cal BCE); site ~23 km inland; central monumental/residential/nonresidential zone ~65 ha; one of 18 large preceramic sites in the Supe Valley. Tier S (journal article presenting primary dates).
